full_prompt_en: A square geometric illustration constructs a large bird-like figure from overlapping flat shapes, mechanical-looking details, and patterned color blocks on a deep black background. The main form stands slightly left of center and extends from near the top to the lower edge. Its head faces right: a pale gold curved beak projects into the dark space, a small red-and-black circular eye sits in a turquoise rectangular head, and layered blue-green fan shapes suggest feathers behind it. A larger concentric disc appears near the back of the head, paired with little triangles, dots, and short marks that echo the smaller eye. Below, the neck and body become a dense vertical assemblage of pale gold bars, teal blocks, red striped arcs, black zigzags, and tiny circular motifs. A broad pale curved band sweeps down the right side of the torso, crossing a dark red half-circle and several patterned panels. The lower portion tapers into long narrow strips and horizontal bars that nearly touch the bottom edge. The figure is assembled like a diagram or ornate machine, yet the beak and feather-like shapes make its animal outline readable. Around it, isolated gold, red, and teal circles hang in the black field. Thin straight lines, tiny dots, and narrow connectors link some of these accents while leaving generous gaps of darkness. At the upper left, a large ochre disc with a small dark center balances the bird's projecting beak. The colors have a matte, slightly aged printed finish rather than glossy plastic surfaces. Illumination is even and graphic, with contrast supplied by the pale and saturated shapes against black rather than by cast shadows. There is no legible text. The overall composition feels precise, playful, and densely ornamented at the center, while the black negative space gives every small mark room to register.
full_prompt_zh: 这是一幅方形几何插画：一个巨大的鸟状形体由重叠的平面形状、似机械的细节和带图案的色块构成，背景是深黑色。主体略偏左，几乎从顶部延伸至下边缘。头朝右：浅金色弯喙伸向暗处，青绿色矩形头部里有一个红黑同心圆眼睛，后方层叠的蓝绿扇形暗示羽毛。头后还有一个更大的同心圆盘，旁边的小三角、圆点和短记号呼应较小的眼睛。下方的颈与身体变为浅金条、蓝绿色块、红色条纹弧形、黑色锯齿和微小圆形纹样组成的密集竖向结构。一条宽阔浅色弯带沿躯干右侧扫下，穿过深红半圆和几块花纹面板。下部收束为细长条带与横杆，几乎触到画面底边。主体像一张图解或华丽机器一样拼装，但鸟喙和羽片状形状仍使其动物轮廓可辨。它周围，孤立的金、红、蓝绿圆点悬浮于黑色场中。细直线、小圆点和窄连接条把其中一些重点连起来，留下大片暗色间隙。左上角，一个中心带小深点的大赭黄圆盘平衡着鸟喙向右伸出的形态。颜色有哑光、略显陈旧的印刷完成面，而非光滑塑料质地。光线均匀而图形化，对比来自黑色前的浅色与饱和形状，而不是投影。画中没有可读文字。整体构图准确、俏皮，中央装饰密集，黑色负空间则让每个小记号都有显现余地。
style_prompt_en: Geometric illustration assembles readable large silhouettes from layered rectangles, arcs, discs, fans, bars, and patterned fragments. Matte teal, aged gold, muted red, and cream stand sharply against a near-black ground. Concentric rings and tiny dots repeat at different scales, tying dense central constructions to isolated peripheral accents. Hard, measured edges establish a diagram-like clarity, while a few sweeping curves keep the structure from becoming rigid. Flat graphic illumination leaves little cast shadow; overlap, scale, and contrast provide depth and focus. Generous dark negative space surrounds the busiest clusters, so fine lines and small ornaments remain distinct. The overall effect is intricate, playful, and mechanically rhythmic.
style_prompt_zh: 几何插画用层叠矩形、弧线、圆盘、扇形、横条和花纹碎片拼装出清楚的大剪影。哑光青绿、旧金色、低调红与奶油色在近黑底上鲜明突出。同心圆与微小圆点以不同尺度反复出现，把密集中央结构与孤立的边缘重点连在一起。坚实、经过衡量的边缘建立图解般清晰度，少量扫动曲线则避免结构僵硬。平面的图形化照明几乎没有投影；重叠、尺度和对比提供纵深与焦点。最繁忙的群组周围保留宽裕暗色负空间，使细线和小装饰各自分明。整体效果繁密、俏皮，带有机械般节奏。
theme_en: A bird-like form built from colorful geometric and mechanical motifs
theme_zh: 由彩色几何与机械纹样拼成的鸟状形体
name: Petros Afshar
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
